description_en: Assigns a role to a member in a workspace, granting that member the role's permissions
description_zh: 为工作空间内的成员添加某个角色，使其拥有角色的权限
name: AddMemberRole

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace. To obtain this ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member. To obtain this ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449135.html
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.help_en:
The role to assign. You can specify a built-in role or a custom role.

Built-in role: You can specify one of the following built-in roles. For the permissions of each role, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html.

`PAI.AlgoDeveloper`: Algorithm developer.

`PAI.AlgoOperator`: Algorithm operator.

`PAI.LabelManager`: Labeling administrator.

`PAI.MaxComputeDeveloper`: MaxCompute developer.

`PAI.WorkspaceAdmin`: Administrator.

`PAI.WorkspaceGuest`: Guest.

`PAI.WorkspaceOwner`: Owner.

Custom role: Specify the ID of the custom role. The ID must be prefixed with `role-`. Example: `role-sw******2tij`
parameters.help_zh:
要添加的角色，支持官方角色与自定义角色：

官方角色：如下所示，各角色权限请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html 。
PAI.AlgoDeveloper：算法开发。
PAI.AlgoOperator：算法运维。
PAI.LabelManager：标注管理员。
PAI.MaxComputeDeveloper：MaxCompute开发。
PAI.WorkspaceAdmin：管理员。
PAI.WorkspaceGuest：访客。
PAI.WorkspaceOwner：负责人。

自定义角色：填写角色ID。格式为role-开头，例如role-sw******2tij
parameters.name: role_name
